#BMS #BMSArchive #BMSworld #BMSEvents #BMSdatabase

I have recorded over 13,500 BMS Autoplay videos since August 2013 and continue to this day.
This channel features auto-played chart preview videos of most of the BMS available at https://www.bmsworld.nz. On my channel you can discover classics from BeatMania 1st mix all the way through to older IIDX charts, other custom BMS events like the BMS of Fighters, PABAT, 東方音弾遊戯, Nameless Heaven, フォルプラス , BMS糞譜面格納庫Revival , インプレ頂上決戦 and more.

BMSworld.NZ continues to be a hobby project only and is not for profit*.
